editorial.headline: Advertising: Nationally Open, but Blocked for PMA Registration in Bali
editorial.standfirst: This activity spans campaign-making, media placement and brand development—open nationally to full foreign ownership, yet unavailable for PMA registration in Bali today.
editorial.body:
Advertising here is the work of creating and carrying campaigns into the places where audiences encounter them. It covers campaign creation and placement, brand identity and brand development, campaign management, and creative advertising materials for print publications, newspapers, radio, television, internet, digital media and other media. The scope also reaches the design of display-site structures, treating advertising as both a creative practice and a matter of physical and media presence.

The activity is generally provided by advertising agencies and media representatives. Its working range is broad: advertisements in print, broadcast, online and outdoor settings; billboards, posters, flyers, brochures, window displays, vehicle advertising and aerial advertising; the sale of media space and time; distribution of advertising materials or samples; billboard space; and exhibition stands and other advertising locations. It also includes marketing campaigns intended to attract and retain customers, including product promotion, point-of-sale marketing and direct mail advertising.

Registration is open across Micro, Small, Medium and Large enterprise scales. Nationally, the status is open, with a maximum foreign ownership level of 100%. In plain terms, foreign ownership may reach full ownership for this activity at the national level. That national position is the one recorded under Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021.

Bali is the material exception. A foreigner cannot register this activity for PMA in Bali today. The Bali status is blocked on risk-class grounds: at the Large scale, OSS risk is assessed as Low or Medium-Low across every scope. Bali’s island-wide, permanent moratorium blocks PMA for activities assessed at those risk levels. The national opening therefore remains real, but it does not translate into PMA registration availability in Bali for this activity.
editorial.pullQuote: A foreigner cannot register this activity for PMA in Bali today.
